## Description

Reduce risk budgets or gross exposure when realized drawdown or portfolio stress reaches pre-set thresholds.

## Where it may fit

Risk control during sustained losses, high volatility or correlated portfolio stress.

## Vehicles

Any systematic fund or leveraged strategy as an overlay.

## Required data

Daily equity curve, peak-to-trough drawdown, realized volatility, exposure, liquidity and re-risking rules.

## Caveats

Can lock in losses or re-enter late; predefine re-risk rules and test path dependence.
